input.title: Prevent duplicate retry notices after reconnect
input.body:
## Goal
Keep one retry notice per job after a websocket reconnect.

## Observed behavior
After the client reconnects, `RetryNoticeStore.add()` appends the active job twice.

## Expected behavior
Reconnect processing reuses the existing notice for the same job identifier.

## Reproduction
Start one job, disconnect the websocket, reconnect once, and inspect the notice list.

## Acceptance criteria
- A reconnect adds exactly one retry notice for the active job.
- A second reconnect remains idempotent.
- Notices for different job identifiers remain distinct.

## Validation
Run `pnpm --filter @example/client test retry-notice`.

## Constraints
Use the existing job identifier as the deduplication key. No schema migration is required.

input.title: Update the integration request identifier contract
input.body:
## Goal
Clarify and implement the request identifier carried by integration payloads.

## Producer contract
Every payload must include a non-empty `requestId` generated by the producer.

## Consumer contract
Integration payloads must never include `requestId`; the consumer generates it after receipt.

## Acceptance criteria
- Producer and consumer contract tests use the same payload schema.
- Existing retries preserve one stable identifier.

## Validation
Run both integration contract suites.

## Decision needed
Choose which side owns identifier generation before implementation begins.

确保个人资料显示名经过保存和重新加载后保持完整。
